result.title: MM-DataLoop: Closing the Data-Side Loop for Recursive Self-Improvement in MLLM Post-Training
result.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a path toward improving models through repeated evaluation and revision. We study its data side in multimodal language model (MLLM) post-training, where heterogeneous operations and cross-round evidence must be coordinated. MMDataLoop organizes data interventions into five operation families and connects them through an Observe-Diagnose-Plan-Execute-Verify-Reflect cycle with shared rule memory. Across 34 candidate rounds on Qwen3.5-0.8B and five benchmarks, we hold the base initialization, shared training schedule and evaluation protocol fixed while varying data recipes. The five-benchmark mean reaches 63.04 at R33, up 5.32 points from the zero-shot baseline; R29, R32, and R33 form a close top cluster within 0.09 points. In eightcandidate comparisons, guided search reaches the preselected target in six candidates and identifies the top observed candidate, while random arms show higher means and lower dispersion. The selected R29 recipe also scores above two full-pool baselines under the same epoch schedule. Together, these findings establish MM-DataLoop as a traceable workflow and provide an empirical basis for studying how data-side decisions shape outcomes across MLLM post-training recipes.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 MM-DataLoop，将 MLLM 后训练中的数据干预组织为五类操作，并以「观察—诊断—规划—执行—验证—反思」循环加共享规则记忆来搜索数据配方，在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 与五个基准上固定其他变量比较多轮候选。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作集中于训练数据配方的搜索与记录，不涉及视觉细节在内部状态中的保留、latent 推理状态的生成或答案对视觉证据的使用，其搜索循环也仅作用于数据侧而非推理期计算，故与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系。
